en.title:
Keep reading.
Stay curious.
en.lead: Explained is an AI reading assistant for Chrome. Highlight an unfamiliar phrase, click to explain it in context, and keep reading.
en.experimental: API edition · Chrome · Your DeepSeek API key required
en.built: A little help for people who read to understand.
en.step1body: The word, concept or acronym that makes you pause.
en.step2body: Click the selection icon or press Ctrl+X (⌘X on Mac) for an explanation beside your reading.
en.step3body: Read on. Or follow your curiosity a little further.
en.demoFooter: Explained · A little context goes a long way
en.demoCaption: A sample explanation, not a live AI answer.
en.practiceTitle: Pick a story. Find a new idea.
en.practiceIntro: Three short reads on AI and research, adapted from Anthropic, OpenAI, and DeepSeek. Highlight a phrase and explore.
en.tip: Already installed? Highlight a phrase, then click its icon or press Ctrl+X (⌘X on Mac).
en.liveGuidance: Enter your DeepSeek API key in the extension setup and enable lookups. Highlight a phrase, then click its icon or press Ctrl+X (⌘X on Mac).
en.welcomeTitle: You’re all set. Let’s try something interesting.
en.welcomeBody: Highlight a phrase, then click its icon or press Ctrl+X (⌘X on Mac) for your first lookup. Selecting or copying alone sends nothing.
en.storyBody: Explained began with an analyst’s reading habit: plenty of interesting ideas, and plenty of things to look up. It’s a small companion for the moment a phrase gets between you and a good story.
en.storyCta: Give it a place in your next read
en.faq1: Do I need an API key?
en.faq1body: Yes. The downloaded API edition requires your own DeepSeek API key and internet access. DeepSeek bills model and search calls to your API account. A DeepSeek website login does not replace an API key.
en.faq2body: Clicking the selection icon or using the shortcut sends selected text and, if enabled, up to 600 nearby characters to DeepSeek. News, time-sensitive lookups and “Explain a little more” also use web search. Selecting or copying alone sends nothing.
en.faq3body: Normal HTML reading pages in Chrome 114 or later. PDFs, browser settings pages and document editors are outside this preview’s scope.
en.footer: A small reading companion. A world of things to understand.
en.installTitle: One small setup. A world to read.
en.installIntro: Download extension-wasm-offline v0.2.1, the Explained API edition for Chrome. It requires your own DeepSeek API key and internet access; model and search calls are billed to your DeepSeek account.
en.install1: Download and unzip the v0.2.1 API edition.
en.install3: Choose Load unpacked and select the folder containing manifest.json.
en.install4: Enter your DeepSeek API key in setup, select Enable lookups, then Start exploring. Refresh any reading page already open.
en.installEyebrow: YOUR NEXT GOOD READ STARTS HERE
en.languageNote: Page language changes the article and samples. Choose the language of live explanations in the extension’s toolbar.
en.connectionTip: Need to set up your API key?
en.connectionBody: Open API settings from the extension toolbar to enter or replace your DeepSeek API key. After enabling lookups, highlight a phrase and click its icon or use the shortcut. API calls are billed to your DeepSeek account.
en.privacyBody: This edition uses DeepSeek’s official APIs with your own key. The key stays only in session memory; preferences are stored locally. Re-enter the key after restarting Chrome or reloading/updating the extension. Selected text, optional nearby context and search queries are sent to DeepSeek when you trigger a lookup. The developer stores no lookup history; DeepSeek handles submitted data under its API policies.
en.privacyTranslation: The full policy below is provided in English.
en.sampleHint: You can highlight any phrase, not just the marked terms.
en.independent: Independent project. Not affiliated with DeepSeek or Google.
en.noscript: All three articles are shown below. JavaScript adds the article switcher; the extension works independently.
en.installPrivacy: Your API key is held only in memory for this browser session. Re-enter it after restarting Chrome or reloading/updating the extension. Triggered lookups send selected text, optional nearby context and any search queries to DeepSeek’s official APIs. API calls are billed to your DeepSeek account.
en.officialSite: utopia-ft.com is the official website of Explained, an AI reading assistant for Chrome.

en.title: Making room for a different cancer treatment
paragraphs: CAR T-cell therapy uses modified immune cells to attack cancer. It has helped patients with {0}. Generate aims to {1} part of the treatment so that it can also work against {2}, which present different challenges.

The team focused on the genetic instructions carried by these cells. Shortening one section could leave space for extra instructions, giving researchers more room to adapt the treatment. Six scientists used Claude Code to explore alternative designs for that section.

Anthropic reports that one candidate was around 70% shorter than the conventional design. Laboratory experiments found that cells using it produced roughly ten times as many receptors, attacked tumor cells more effectively, and stayed active longer.

These findings concern an early design tested in a laboratory. They do not establish how a finished treatment would perform in patients. The example shows how AI can contribute a testable proposal while scientists build it, measure its behavior, and decide what to investigate next.
notes: Cancers involving blood-forming or immune cells, such as leukemia.
Redesign a treatment component to change what it can do.
Cancers forming masses in tissues or organs.

cn.title: 为癌症疗法腾出新的可能
paragraphs: CAR T 细胞疗法通过改造免疫细胞来攻击癌症，已经帮助治疗了一些{0}。Generate 希望{1}这一疗法的一部分，让它也能应对{2}。不同类型的癌症，给治疗带来的挑战也不同。
团队把注意力放在这些细胞携带的遗传指令上。如果能缩短其中一个片段，就可能腾出空间，加入适用于其他癌症的指令。六位科学家使用 Claude Code，为这个片段探索不同的设计。
据 Anthropic 报道，其中一个候选设计比常规版本短约 70%。实验室测试发现，采用这一设计的细胞产生了约十倍数量的受体，攻击肿瘤细胞的效率更高，保持活性的时间也更长。
这些发现来自早期设计的实验室测试，还不能说明最终疗法在患者身上的表现。这个案例展示了一种合作方式：AI 提出可以验证的方案，科学家将其做出来、测量效果，再决定下一步研究什么。
notes: 影响造血细胞或免疫细胞的癌症，例如白血病。文中将它们与形成实体肿块的癌症相比较。
调整疗法的设计和工作方式。这里指 Generate 改造 CAR T 细胞，以应对更多癌症类型。
在器官或组织中形成实体肿块的癌症。文中所述工作的目标，是让 CAR T 细胞疗法也适用于这些癌症。

tw.title: 為癌症療法騰出新的可能
paragraphs: CAR T 細胞療法透過改造免疫細胞來攻擊癌症，已經幫助治療了一些{0}。Generate 希望{1}這一療法的一部分，讓它也能應對{2}。不同類型的癌症，給治療帶來的挑戰也不同。
團隊把注意力放在這些細胞攜帶的遺傳指令上。如果能縮短其中一個片段，就可能騰出空間，加入適用於其他癌症的指令。六位科學家使用 Claude Code，為這個片段探索不同的設計。
據 Anthropic 報導，其中一個候選設計比常規版本短約 70%。實驗室測試發現，採用這一設計的細胞產生了約十倍數量的受體，攻擊腫瘤細胞的效率更高，保持活性的時間也更長。
這些發現來自早期設計的實驗室測試，還不能說明最終療法在患者身上的表現。這個案例展示了一種合作方式：AI 提出可以驗證的方案，科學家將其做出來、測量效果，再決定下一步研究什麼。
notes: 影響造血細胞或免疫細胞的癌症，例如白血病。文中將它們與形成實體腫塊的癌症相比較。
調整療法的設計和運作方式。這裡指 Generate 改造 CAR T 細胞，以應對更多癌症類型。
在器官或組織中形成實體腫塊的癌症。文中所述工作的目標，是讓 CAR T 細胞療法也適用於這些癌症。

en.title: From an AI proof to shared understanding
paragraphs: When mathematical waves concentrate, their most extreme behavior may last only briefly. The {0} describes how averaging over time limits that concentration. OpenAI reports that its models have produced a proof covering every dimension, with consequences for other longstanding questions.

The announcement also describes results in computer science and physics. Across these fields, a new challenge follows the initial output: helping other researchers understand the argument, check its reasoning, and work out what it changes.

For the mathematical result, OpenAI released both a written argument and a version formalized in {1}, a system for checking mathematical proofs. For the other results, outside researchers are organizing collaborations, with different arrangements for publishing the underlying materials.

The proposed process emphasizes {2}. Participants can discuss their work and publish their own conclusions. A checked proof and a useful explanation serve different purposes: one verifies formal steps, while the other helps a community see the ideas, assumptions, and implications behind them.
notes: A statement limiting wave concentration after averaging over time.
A proof assistant that checks formally specified mathematical steps.
Assessment by researchers free to reach their own conclusions.

cn.title: 从 AI 证明，到共同理解
paragraphs: 数学中的波在集中时，最极端的状态可能只会短暂出现。{0}讨论的，是在时间上取平均之后，这种集中会受到怎样的限制。OpenAI 报道，其模型给出了适用于所有维度的证明，并对其他长期悬而未决的问题产生影响。
这份公告还介绍了计算机科学和物理学方面的结果。在这些领域，最初的输出之后还有一项工作：让其他研究者读懂论证、检查推理，并弄清它究竟改变了什么。
对于数学结果，OpenAI 公开了文字论证，以及使用证明检查系统 {1} 形式化的版本。对于其他结果，外部研究者正在组织合作，并分别决定底层材料的发布方式。
这一流程强调{2}。参与者可以讨论工作，也可以发表自己的结论。通过检查的证明与清楚易懂的解释各有作用：前者验证形式化步骤，后者帮助学术共同体理解背后的思想、假设与影响。
notes: 讨论在时间上取平均后，波的集中程度受到何种限制的数学命题。
检查形式化数学步骤的证明辅助系统。
由能够自主得出结论的研究者开展的审查。

tw.title: 從 AI 證明，到共同理解
paragraphs: 數學中的波在集中時，最極端的狀態可能只會短暫出現。{0}討論的，是在時間上取平均之後，這種集中會受到怎樣的限制。OpenAI 報導，其模型給出了適用於所有維度的證明，並對其他長期懸而未決的問題產生影響。
這份公告還介紹了電腦科學和物理學方面的結果。在這些領域，最初的輸出之後還有一項工作：讓其他研究者讀懂論證、檢查推理，並弄清它究竟改變了什麼。
對於數學結果，OpenAI 公開了文字論證，以及使用證明檢查系統 {1} 形式化的版本。對於其他結果，外部研究者正在組織合作，並分別決定底層材料的發布方式。
這一流程強調{2}。參與者可以討論工作，也可以發表自己的結論。通過檢查的證明與清楚易懂的解釋各有作用：前者驗證形式化步驟，後者幫助學術共同體理解背後的思想、假設與影響。
notes: 討論在時間上取平均後，波的集中程度受到何種限制的數學命題。
檢查形式化數學步驟的證明輔助系統。
由能夠自主得出結論的研究者開展的審查。

en.title: What it takes to read a million tokens
paragraphs: A language model handling a long document must carry information forward as it generates an answer. A {0} makes that challenge much larger. The DeepSeek-V4 report presents two models designed to make this scale of input more practical.

The central change is a hybrid attention system. One component compresses stored information and selects relevant entries; another uses stronger compression while retaining dense attention over the compressed entries. Together, they reduce the resources required to handle long sequences.

The report compares DeepSeek-V4-Pro with DeepSeek-V3.2 at a million tokens. For generating one token, it reports {1} of 27% and a {2} of 10% relative to the earlier model. These figures describe computation and cached attention data under the stated comparison.

That distinction matters when reading efficiency claims. Lower computation and memory requirements can make extended tasks more feasible, but they do not by themselves specify response speed, price, or answer quality. The paper connects these savings to future work on longer reasoning and tasks spanning many documents.
notes: An input window holding up to a million model tokens.
Floating-point operations used during model inference.
Stored attention keys and values reused during text generation.

cn.title: 读完一百万 token，需要什么？
terms: 一百万 token 上下文
paragraphs: 语言模型处理长文档时，需要在生成回答的过程中持续利用前文信息。{0}会让这一挑战显著增加。DeepSeek-V4 技术报告介绍了两个模型，目标是让如此大规模的输入更容易实际使用。
核心变化是一套混合注意力系统。其中一部分先压缩已存储的信息，再挑选相关条目；另一部分采用更强的压缩，同时对压缩后的条目保留密集注意力。两者结合，减少处理长序列所需的资源。
报告在一百万 token 的条件下，将 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 与 DeepSeek-V3.2 作比较。生成单个 token 时，前者的{1}为后者的 27%，{2}为后者的 10%。这些数字描述的是指定比较条件下的计算量和注意力缓存。
阅读效率指标时，区分它们的含义很有必要。更低的计算量和内存需求，可以让持续时间更长的任务更可行，但不能单凭这些数字判断响应速度、价格或回答质量。论文将这些节省与更长的推理、跨多份文档的任务等后续研究联系起来。
notes: 可容纳多达一百万个 token 的输入窗口；token 是模型表示文本等内容时使用的单位。
运行模型所需的浮点运算次数。这里比较的是生成单个 token 所需的计算量。
生成时重复使用的注意力键和值。缩小这一缓存，可以减少处理长输入时的内存需求。

tw.title: 讀完一百萬 token，需要什麼？
terms: 一百萬 token 上下文
paragraphs: 語言模型處理長文件時，需要在生成回答的過程中持續利用前文資訊。{0}會讓這一挑戰顯著增加。DeepSeek-V4 技術報告介紹了兩個模型，目標是讓如此大規模的輸入更容易實際使用。
核心變化是一套混合注意力系統。其中一部分先壓縮已儲存的資訊，再挑選相關條目；另一部分採用更強的壓縮，同時對壓縮後的條目保留密集注意力。兩者結合，減少處理長序列所需的資源。
報告在一百萬 token 的條件下，將 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 與 DeepSeek-V3.2 作比較。生成單個 token 時，前者的{1}為後者的 27%，{2}為後者的 10%。這些數字描述的是指定比較條件下的計算量和注意力快取。
閱讀效率指標時，區分它們的含義很有必要。更低的計算量和記憶體需求，可以讓持續時間更長的任務更可行，但不能單憑這些數字判斷回應速度、價格或回答品質。論文將這些節省與更長的推理、跨多份文件的任務等後續研究聯繫起來。
notes: 可容納多達一百萬個 token 的輸入視窗；token 是模型表示文字等內容時使用的單位。
執行模型所需的浮點運算次數。這裡比較的是生成單個 token 所需的計算量。
生成時重複使用的注意力鍵和值。縮小這一快取，可以減少處理長輸入時的記憶體需求。
